assets.arrival-harbor.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original panoramic environment plate for an immersive first-person xianxia boat arrival in a mobile romance game named 渡月行. Create an extraordinarily detailed cinematic realistic Chinese fantasy harbor at blue hour. Viewpoint low over a wide dark jade water canal, aligned perfectly down its center, 16:9 landscape composition. The center is an OPEN water passage with a clear distant vanishing point at 48% image height. Monumental stacked wooden waterside pavilions climb cliff terraces on BOTH banks, old weathered timber, green glazed curved tiled eaves, hundreds of small warm amber lanterns with delicate reflections, narrow stone stairs descend directly to water, a few moored small boats and tiny adult figures for scale. Far above the center water corridor a delicate high stone bridge connects two floating mountain islands; silver mist hangs around mountain feet; cloud roots and waterfalls beyond. Foreground canal water occupies lower 40%, unobstructed, nothing large in the foreground, NO foreground boat, NO hands, NO close characters, NO large archway across foreground. Architectural realism, tactile materials, atmospheric scale, restrained luminous magic, like an expensive live-action fantasy film environment rather than anime. Cool petrol teal atmosphere balanced by warm lit windows, no purple neon, no text, labels, logos, subtitles, border or watermark. Original design only, do not copy an existing video.
assets.arrival-gate.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent foreground environment cutout for a first-person boat passing through a Chinese fantasy harbor gate. One monumental ancient Chinese stone water gate seen perfectly straight on at low water eye level. Two dark weathered stone piers at the extreme left and right support a very high semicircular central opening and a wide carved stone lintel, topped with a narrow teal tiled double-eaved Chinese roof. Tiny warm amber lanterns hang from the roof corners, worn gold ornamental fish motifs, subtle barnacles on stone bases, cinematic photorealistic detailed material. The arch opening is enormous and completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT, occupies center 65% width and lower 78% height; bottom middle remains open all the way to the canvas bottom. Isolate only gate and lanterns, no water, no buildings, no landscape, no ground, no writing, no text, no black fill inside arch. Entire background and arch opening must be genuinely transparent alpha. Landscape 16:9, full roof and piers visible with a small margin, no clipping. Original fantasy game environment.
assets.arrival-boat.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent foreground cutout for immersive first-person Chinese fantasy boat ride, landscape 16:9. View looking down and forward from the seated passenger on a small weathered dark wooden skiff. The elegant pointed wooden bow rises at bottom center, with short side gunwales extending from lower left and lower right toward a vanishing point at center 58% of image height. Only the bottom 40% of canvas contains the bow, gunwales, some deck planks, two naturally posed adult woman's hands resting gently on the left and right gunwales, wearing muted pale jade flowing Chinese sleeves. One small unlit mooring rope coil on deck, quiet realistic tactile timber, cinematic dim cool blue hour light with very faint warm amber side light. Upper 58% of canvas completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT. Background and all space outside the skiff and hands must be genuinely transparent alpha, no water or scenery, no horizon, no text, no logos. Symmetrical centered perspective so boat points exactly forward. Five anatomically correct fingers on each hand, sleeves opaque, no detached body parts.
